titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de partenaires Solutions (100 % distant)

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, the Solutions Partner Manager is responsible for managing, enabling, and governing a network of consulting firms, system integrators, and delivery partners who implement Tether products (WDK, QVAC, and MOS). The role ensures partners deliver high-quality projects, align with Tether’s interests, meet certification standards, and drive customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities
 1. Partner Relationship & Capability Management

• Act as the primary relationship owner for all Solutions Partners.

• Coordinate the assessment of partner capabilities, delivery maturity, and resources.

• Ensure partners maintain sufficient certified consultants and technical capacity.

• Conduct regular capability reviews and develop partner improvement plans as needed.

2. Partner Onboarding & Certification

• Lead the onboarding of new implementation partners, including due diligence and contract execution.

• Coordinate partner training and certification programs

• Ensure adherence to implementation playbooks, best practices, and delivery frameworks.

3. Delivery Governance

• Oversee partner-led implementations to ensure alignment with methodology, quality standards, and timelines.

• Participate in project kick-offs, milestone reviews, and governance checkpoints.

• Validate partner deliverables (e.g., configurations, integration setups, testing documentation).

• Manage escalations and coordinate resolutions with internal Technical, Support, and Product teams.

4. Project Portfolio Monitoring

• Maintain visibility over the entire portfolio of partner-led projects.

• Identify and flag cross-sell opportunities with other Tether products or with services offered by Tether portfolio companies, where relevant.

• Track delivery risks, resourcing gaps, and escalations across the partner ecosystem.

• Ensure Partners receive Technical support as required during their implementations

5. Quality Assurance & Performance Management

• Monitor KPIs such as project success rate, CSAT, and partner delivery quality.

• Perform quarterly partner performance reviews.

• Define corrective action plans or temporary delivery restrictions when required.

• Manage re-certification cycles and partner tiering.

7. Cross-Functional Coordination

• Work closely with Customer Success, Delivery, Support, Product, and Training teams.

• Ensure smooth transitions between sales-to-delivery and delivery-to-support phases.

• Provide feedback from partner projects to internal teams to improve product quality and implementation processes.

8. Partner Lifecycle Management

• Manage partner renewal, re-certification, and (if necessary) offboarding.

• Maintain partner records, capability matrices, and project performance logs.

• 4–8 years in Partner Management, Delivery Management, Professional Services, or Project Governance roles.

• Experience working with implementation partners, system integrators, or consulting firms.

• Strong understanding of software/IT implementation processes (integration, configuration, change management, UAT, go-live).

• Collaborate with world-class technical and business teams across multiple regions.

• Experience in SaaS, fintech, AI, blockchain, digital content platforms, or enterprise open source software.

• Previous work with partner-led delivery models or certification programs.

• Knowledge of partner governance tools, PMO frameworks, and QA processes.

• English is a must, any other language a plus

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

• We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship in 2025/2026. MSc/PhD Internships at Tether aim to provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, and to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies.

• In our team, you will have the opportunity to participate in the development of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) foundation models, and will also be responsible for optimizing our distributed model training framework continuously.

• PhD internships at Tether provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, and to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies. Our dynamic internship experience blends hands-on learning, enriching community-building and development events, and collaboration with industry experts.

• Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply early. Please state your availability clearly in your resume (Start date, End date).

Responsibilities

• Research and develop state-of-the-art LLM and/or video or multimodality models to accelerate open-source progress in the domains.

• Implement the application of large models in our business scenarios, like pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference etc.

• Continuously optimize the training framework to better adapt to the training of large models on thousands of multi-node GPUs.

 • Track progress, manage dependencies, and proactively identify risks or blockers
 • Ensure projects are delivered on time, on scope, and aligned with business objectives

Cross-Functional Alignment
 • Serve as the primary liaison between Marketing, Product, and Development to ensure alignment on priorities and execution
 • Translate product and technical requirements into clear design and marketing briefs
 • Facilitate regular check-ins, reviews, and feedback loops to keep stakeholders aligned

Digital & Website Execution
 • Oversee website launches and updates, including coordinating design, content, and development changes
 • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment across digital touchpoints
 • Manage content updates across CMS, landing pages, and marketing platforms in collaboration with designers and developers

Operational Support & Process Improvement
 • Establish and refine processes, templates, and tools to improve efficiency and clarity within the marketing design workflow
 • Maintain documentation for project tracking, status reporting, and post-launch reviews
 • Support campaign execution, events, and other marketing initiatives as needed

•	3+ years of experience in marketing project management, design operations, or a similar role
 
• Proven experience managing design workflows and coordinating cross-functional teams
 
• Demonstrated success leading website and digital products launch, including close collaboration with design and development teams

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Marketing Project Manager to drive execution across the marketing design function. In this role, you will manage workflows for designers, ensure clear scope definition, and align priorities with Product, and Development teams.

You will act as the central point of coordination, translating product requirements into clear, actionable briefs, managing timelines and dependencies, and ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly structured, and experienced in working with cross-functional, globally distributed teams on AI-driven software products or digital wallet solutions.

Responsibilities
Project & Workflow Management
• Own and manage the end-to-end workflow for marketing design projects, from intake and scoping through delivery and launch
• Define and document clear project scope, requirements, timelines, and deliverables for designers
• Prioritize incoming requests in partnership with Product and Development teams, balancing urgency, impact, and capacity
• Track progress, manage dependencies, and proactively identify risks or blockers
• Ensure projects are delivered on time, on scope, and aligned with business objectives

Cross-Functional Alignment
• Serve as the primary liaison between Marketing, Product, and Development to ensure alignment on priorities and execution
• Translate product and technical requirements into clear design and marketing briefs
• Facilitate regular check-ins, reviews, and feedback loops to keep stakeholders aligned

Digital & Website Execution
• Oversee website launches and updates, including coordinating design, content, and development changes
• Ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment across digital touchpoints
• Manage content updates across CMS, landing pages, and marketing platforms in collaboration with designers and developers

Operational Support & Process Improvement
• Establish and refine processes, templates, and tools to improve efficiency and clarity within the marketing design workflow
• Maintain documentation for project tracking, status reporting, and post-launch reviews
• Support campaign execution, events, and other marketing initiatives as needed

• 3+ years of experience in marketing project management, design operations, or a similar role
• Proven experience managing design workflows and coordinating cross-functional teams
• Demonstrated success leading website and digital products launch, including close collaboration with design and development teams
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
• Familiarity with CMS platforms and digital marketing workflows
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
• Experience working in a fully remote environment with global teams
• Background in tech, finance, or infrastructure-related industries is a plus
• Italian or Spanish fluency is a bonus

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Tether sta cercando un Blockchain Expansion Manager per guidare iniziative di crescita strategica attraverso l'ecosistema partner blockchain di Tether. Questo ruolo si trova all'interno della funzione Blockchain Expansion e si concentra sulla costruzione e la gestione di relazioni ad alto impatto con le basi blockchain, eseguendo progetti strategici che espandono l'adozione del mondo reale e l'utilità dei beni Tether.
Il Blockchain Expansion Manager lavorerà a stretto contatto con i partner blockchain per progettare e fornire iniziative che crescano in modo significativo l’utilizzo delle risorse di Tether attraverso casi pratici e reali di utilizzo. Questo ruolo richiede forti capacità di gestione del partenariato, pensiero strategico, e la capacità di eseguire progetti complessi attraverso più stakeholder interni ed esterni.
Questo è un ruolo pratico adatto a qualcuno che prospera in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione, opera con autonomia, e porta struttura e rigore a iniziative di crescita ad alto impatto.

responsabilità

• Gestire e approfondire le relazioni strategiche con le basi blockchain e i partner ecosistemici.
Agire come punto di contatto principale per i partner blockchain assegnati, garantendo l’allineamento tra gli obiettivi dei partner e le priorità strategiche di Tether.

• Progettare ed eseguire progetti di crescita ad alto impatto in collaborazione con partner blockchain per guidare l'adozione dei beni Tether attraverso casi di utilizzo nel mondo reale.

• Pensate strategicamente a come Tether può lavorare con gli ecosistemi blockchain per creare progetti scalabili e sostenibili che espandono l'utilizzo e la circolazione degli asset.

• Coordinare e gestire iniziative interfunzionali che coinvolgono espansione regionale, economia, marketing e altre squadre interne.

• Tracciare, gestire e segnalare i progressi del progetto, i risultati e l'efficacia, assicurando le iniziative di consegna contro obiettivi definiti.

• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'efficienza dell'esecuzione, la struttura del progetto e i risultati dei partner.

• Operare con un alto grado di autonomia, prendendo iniziativa per identificare nuove opportunità e spingerli avanti.

• Supporta la leadership interna con aggiornamenti chiari, approfondimenti e raccomandazioni basate sulle prestazioni del partner e del progetto.

Mandato

• Esperienza comprovata nella partnership o nella gestione degli ecosistemi, idealmente all'interno di cripto, fintech o tecnologia.

• Forte track record di gestione di progetti di crescita strategica ad alto impatto dal concetto attraverso l'esecuzione.

• Eccellente capacità organizzative con un alto livello di attenzione ai dettagli.

• Capacità di tracciare, gestire e ottimizzare simultaneamente più iniziative.

• Forte capacità di pensiero strategico con la capacità di tradurre idee in progetti eseguibili.

• Esperienza di lavoro cross-funzionale con team come espansione, economia, marketing o prodotto.

• Capacità di lavorare autonomamente, prendere iniziativa e operare efficacemente in un ambiente remoto e globale.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale inglese.

Preferito

• Esperienza di lavoro con fondazioni blockchain o ecosistemi Layer 1 / Layer 2.

• Familiarity con stabilicoin, infrastruttura blockchain, o casi di uso blockchain del mondo reale.

• Esperienza operativa in ambienti in rapida crescita o non strutturati.

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.

• Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

• Strong track record of managing high-impact, strategic growth projects from concept through execution.

• Excellent organisational skills with a high level of attention to detail .

• Ability to track, manage, and optimise multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate ideas into executable projects.

• Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as expansion, economics, marketing, or product.

• Ability to work autonomously, take initiative, and operate effectively in a remote, global environment.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred

• Experience working with blockchain foundations or Layer 1 / Layer 2 ecosystems.

• Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, or real-world blockchain use cases.

• Experience operating in fast-growing or unstructured environments.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen
Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere innovativen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen - von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten -, reservegestützte Token nahtlos in Blockchains zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie können Sie digitale Token sofort, sicher und global zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten speichern, senden und empfangen. Transparenz ist das Fundament von allem, was wir tun, und gewährleistet das Vertrauen in jede Transaktion.

Innovation mit Tether
Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite verfügt über den weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte von Millionen weltweit verlassen, neben bahnbrechenden Tokenisierungsdiensten für digitale Vermögenswerte.
Aber das ist erst der Anfang:
Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen, die nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben, optimieren überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in hochmodernen, geodiversen Anlagen.
Tether Data: Durch die Förderung von Durchbrüchen in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert.
Tether Education: Indem wir den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen demokratisieren, befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaften zu gedeihen und das globale Wachstum und die Chancen zu fördern.
Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus der Ferne aus allen Ecken der Welt arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Tether sucht einen Blockchain Expansion Manager, um strategische Wachstumsinitiativen im gesamten Blockchain-Partner-Ökosystem von Tether voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle liegt in der Blockchain-Erweiterungsfunktion und konzentriert sich auf den Aufbau und die Verwaltung von einflussreichen Beziehungen zu Blockchain-Stiftungen, während strategische Projekte durchgeführt werden, die die reale Einführung und den Nutzen von Tether-Assets erweitern.
Der Blockchain Expansion Manager wird eng mit Blockchain-Partnern zusammenarbeiten, um Initiativen zu entwickeln und zu liefern, die die Nutzung von Tether durch praktische, reale Anwendungsfälle sinnvoll steigern. Diese Rolle erfordert starke Fähigkeiten im Partnerschaftsmanagement, strategisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Projekte mit mehreren internen und externen Stakeholdern durchzuführen.
Dies ist eine praktische Rolle, die für jemanden geeignet ist, der in einer sich schnell bewegenden Umgebung gedeiht, autonom arbeitet und Struktur und Strenge für einflussreiche Wachstumsinitiativen bringt.

Zuständigkeiten

• Verwalten und vertiefen Sie strategische Beziehungen zu Blockchain-Stiftungen und Ökosystempartnern.
Handeln Sie als primärer Ansprechpartner für zugewiesene Blockchain-Partner und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Partnerziele und die strategischen Prioritäten von Tether aufeinander abgestimmt werden.

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie wirkungsvolle Wachstumsprojekte in Zusammenarbeit mit Blockchain-Partnern, um die Einführung von Tether-Assets durch reale Anwendungsfälle zu fördern.

• Denken Sie strategisch darüber nach, wie Tether mit Blockchain-Ökosystemen zusammenarbeiten kann, um skalierbare, nachhaltige Projekte zu schaffen, die die Nutzung und den Umlauf von Vermögenswerten erweitern.

• Koordinieren und verwalten Sie funktionsübergreifende Initiativen mit regionaler Expansion, Wirtschaft, Marketing und anderen internen Teams.

• Verfolgen, verwalten und berichten Sie über den Projektfortschritt, die Ergebnisse und die Wirksamkeit, um sicherzustellen, dass die Initiativen bestimmte Ziele erreichen.

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Ausführungseffizienz, der Projektstruktur und der Partnerergebnisse.

• Arbeiten Sie mit einem hohen Maß an Autonomie, ergreifen Sie die Initiative, neue Chancen zu identifizieren und sie voranzutreiben.

• Unterstützen Sie die interne Führung mit klaren Updates, Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen basierend auf der Leistung von Partnern und Projekten.

obligatorisch

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Partnerschafts- oder Ökosystemmanagement, idealerweise in Krypto, Fintech oder Technologie.

• Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung von einflussreichen, strategischen Wachstumsprojekten von der Konzeption bis zur Ausführung.

• Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit einem hohen Maß an Liebe zum Detail.

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Initiativen gleichzeitig zu verfolgen, zu verwalten und zu optimieren.

• Starke strategische Denkfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Ideen in ausführbare Projekte zu übersetzen.

• Erfahrung in der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Teams wie Expansion, Wirtschaft, Marketing oder Produkt.

• Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten, Initiative zu ergreifen und effektiv in einer abgelegenen, globalen Umgebung zu arbeiten.

• Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Bevorzugt

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Blockchain-Stiftungen oder Layer 1 / Layer 2 Ökosystemen.

• Vertrautheit mit Stablecoins, Blockchain-Infrastruktur oder realen Blockchain-Anwendungsfällen.

• Erfahrung in schnell wachsenden oder unstrukturierten Umgebungen.

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben LinkedIn-Profile verifiziert. Wenn sie unsicher sind, können sie ihre identität bestätigen, indem sie ihr profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere website kontaktieren.

• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.

• Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden.

• Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details verlangen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, ist dies ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort.

Im zweifelsfall, fühlen sie sich frei, über unsere offizielle website zu erreichen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début:
Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Tether est à la recherche d'un gestionnaire d'expansion Blockchain pour conduire des initiatives de croissance stratégique dans l'écosystème partenaire de la chaîne de blocs de Tether. Ce rôle s'inscrit dans la fonction Expansion Blockchain et se concentre sur la construction et la gestion de relations à haut impact avec les fondations Blockchain tout en exécutant des projets stratégiques qui élargissent l'adoption et l'utilité réelles des actifs de Tether.
Le gestionnaire d'expansion de Blockchain travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires de Blockchain pour concevoir et livrer des initiatives qui augmentent significativement l'utilisation de l'actif de l'entreprise par des cas pratiques et réels. Ce rôle exige de solides compétences en gestion de partenariat, une réflexion stratégique et la capacité d'exécuter des projets complexes auprès de multiples intervenants internes et externes.
Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique adapté à quelqu'un qui prospère dans un environnement en évolution rapide, fonctionne avec autonomie et apporte structure et rigueur aux initiatives de croissance à impact élevé.

Responsabilités

• Gérer et approfondir les relations stratégiques avec les fondations de la blockchain et les partenaires écosystémiques.
Agir comme point de contact principal pour les partenaires de la chaîne de blocs assignés, en assurant l'alignement entre les objectifs des partenaires et les priorités stratégiques de Tether.

• Concevoir et exécuter des projets de croissance à impact élevé en collaboration avec des partenaires de blockchain pour stimuler l'adoption des actifs de Tether à travers des cas d'utilisation du monde réel.

• Pensez stratégiquement à la façon dont Tether peut travailler avec les écosystèmes blockchain pour créer des projets évolutifs et durables qui augmentent l'utilisation et la circulation des actifs.

• Coordonner et gérer les initiatives interfonctionnelles faisant intervenir l'expansion régionale, l'économie, le marketing et d'autres équipes internes.

• Suivre, gérer et rendre compte de l'avancement, des résultats et de l'efficacité des projets, en veillant à ce que les initiatives soient mises en oeuvre par rapport aux objectifs définis.

• Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer l'efficacité de l'exécution, la structure du projet et les résultats des partenaires.

• Exploiter avec un degré élevé d'autonomie, prendre des initiatives pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités et les faire avancer.

• Appuyer le leadership interne par des mises à jour, des idées et des recommandations claires fondées sur le rendement des partenaires et des projets.

Obligatoire

• Expérience éprouvée dans le partenariat ou la gestion de l'écosystème, idéalement dans crypto, fintech, ou la technologie.

• Forte expérience de la gestion des projets de croissance stratégique à fort impact du concept à l'exécution.

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles avec un haut niveau d'attention aux détails .

• Capacité de suivre, gérer et optimiser simultanément plusieurs initiatives.

• Forte capacité de réflexion stratégique avec la capacité de traduire des idées en projets exécutables.

• Expérience de travail interfonctionnel avec des équipes comme l'expansion, l'économie, le marketing ou le produit.

• Capacité de travailler de façon autonome, de prendre des initiatives et de fonctionner efficacement dans un environnement mondial éloigné.

• Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale en anglais.

Préféré

• Expérience de travail avec les fondations de blockchain ou les écosystèmes de Layer 1 / Layer 2.

• Familiarité avec des pièces stables, l'infrastructure de blockchain, ou cas d'utilisation de blockchain du monde réel.

• Expérience de fonctionnement dans des environnements à croissance rapide ou non structuré.

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lors de la demande de rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Faites attention aux méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par le biais de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team, to lead efforts in the Middle East. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the crypto-asset industry / stablecoin industry in the Middle East, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
 To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, and regulatory requirements.
 You will have a focus around working with regulators to translate policy objectives of the companies into favourable regulatory requirements in the region, as part of enabling the broader business strategy across Tether’s business verticals.
 The successful candidate should be comfortable managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business, including regulators and policy setters, as well as working with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Finance, Technology, Business Development.
 You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory affairs initiatives.

Responsibilities:
 Regulatory Affairs

• Monitor regulatory developments impacting Tether and affiliates companies in the region.

• Maintain active relationships with policymakers, regulators, central banks, and financial intelligence units.

• Represent the company in consultations, workshops, industry roundtables, and regulatory dialogues.

• Prepare briefing papers, comment letters, and policy submissions aligned with broader global regulatory strategy.

• Identify and successfully realise opportunities to shape emerging frameworks in a risk-sensitive, innovation-oriented manner.

Licensing & Authorisations

• Conduct structured assessments on whether licensing/registration is required for operations in the region.

• Working with your team and local advisor, you will be responsible for successfully obtaining regulatory authorisations in the region, where required.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Support enterprise-level planning for new products or expansions in the region, advising on regulatory constraints and enablers to the Company’s leadership.

• Contribute to internal reporting and executive briefings on policy risks and regulatory trajectory regionally.

• Minimum of 8 years governmental affairs / regulatory affairs / legal experience ideally within the financial services or crypto-asset industry in the Middle East.

• Proven ability in successfully leading regulatory affairs teams within either the financial services industry, or the digital asset industry.

• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team, to lead efforts in the Middle East. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the crypto-asset industry / stablecoin industry in the Middle East, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, and regulatory requirements.
You will have a focus around working with regulators to translate policy objectives of the companies into favourable regulatory requirements in the region, as part of enabling the broader business strategy across Tether’s business verticals.
The successful candidate should be comfortable managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business, including regulators and policy setters, as well as working with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Finance, Technology, Business Development.
You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory affairs initiatives.

Responsibilities:
Regulatory Affairs

• Monitor regulatory developments impacting Tether and affiliates companies in the region.

• Maintain active relationships with policymakers, regulators, central banks, and financial intelligence units.

• Represent the company in consultations, workshops, industry roundtables, and regulatory dialogues.

• Prepare briefing papers, comment letters, and policy submissions aligned with broader global regulatory strategy.

• Identify and successfully realise opportunities to shape emerging frameworks in a risk-sensitive, innovation-oriented manner.

Licensing & Authorisations

• Conduct structured assessments on whether licensing/registration is required for operations in the region.

• Working with your team and local advisor, you will be responsible for successfully obtaining regulatory authorisations in the region, where required.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Support enterprise-level planning for new products or expansions in the region, advising on regulatory constraints and enablers to the Company’s leadership.

• Contribute to internal reporting and executive briefings on policy risks and regulatory trajectory regionally.

• Minimum of 8 years governmental affairs / regulatory affairs / legal experience ideally within the financial services or crypto-asset industry in the Middle East.

• Proven ability in successfully leading regulatory affairs teams within either the financial services industry, or the digital asset industry.

• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team as Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the digital-asset industry / stablecoin industry, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
 The Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations will lead the development and execution of our global authorisations strategy across key jurisdictions, working through a geographically distributed team of regional regulatory affairs and licensing teams. This role is responsible for securing and maintaining regulatory approvals required for the company’s operations, ensuring alignment with shifting regulatory landscapes, and enabling sustainable market expansion.
 As a senior leader within the Regulatory Affairs & Licensing function, you will collaborate closely with regional licensing personnel, legal, compliance, product, and executive leadership to drive licensing initiatives end-to-end—from early regulatory assessments and submissions through to supervisory engagement and operational readiness. The ideal candidate brings deep multi-jurisdictional licensing expertise, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate across regions in a cohesive, consistent manner.
 You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory Affairs and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory and licensing initiatives.

Responsibilities
 Licensing Strategy & Execution

• Design and implement a unified global licensing strategy, ensuring consistency across regional approaches.

• Work closely with regional licensing personnel to assess regulatory pathways, evaluate market feasibility, and prioritise jurisdictions.

• Oversee and guide the preparation, submission, and management of licensing applications and / or other regulatory authorisation processes, in collaboration with regional teams.

• Ensure alignment between regional licensing efforts and global business priorities.

Regional Coordination & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the central point of coordination for licensing and regulatory authorisation activity across all regions, ensuring standards, documentation, and approaches remain cohesive.

• Provide direct support, guidance, and escalation oversight to regional licensing personnel.

• Align regulatory authorisation efforts with regulatory affairs leads to coordinate regulatory engagement strategies across regions.

Regulatory Engagement

• Act as a senior representative in regulatory engagements where global coordination or executive-level involvement is required.

• Support regional teams in interactions with local regulators, offering strategic guidance and ensuring consistent messaging.

Operational Readiness & Governance

• Coordinate with regional teams to ensure their understanding around local regulatory requirements such that they are prepared to meet jurisdictional authorisation obligations, where needed and / or desired, including governance, capital, operational, and reporting requirements.

• Maintain global oversight of regulatory authorisation conditions, ensuring local compliance is consistent with global policies and standards.

• Lead responses to cross-regional regulatory queries or supervisory reviews related to authorisation activities.

Market Expansion & Risk Analysis

• Work with regional personnel to conduct regulatory feasibility assessments for new markets and product expansions.

• Provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership on prioritisation of authorisation efforts and regulatory risk.

Team Leadership

• Lead and mentor the global regulatory and licensing team, including regional leads and supporting personnel.

• Build capability, consistency, and knowledge-sharing across regions to strengthen the company’s global licensing and authorisations function.

• Promote a culture of regulatory excellence, transparency, and disciplined execution.

Experience & Expertise

• 10+ years of experience in regulatory licensing and authorisations, regulatory affairs, compliance, or related fields (financial services, payments, fintech, crypto, or technology).

• Proven experience managing complex regulatory authorisation processes across multiple regions or markets.

• Strong understanding of diverse regulatory frameworks and supervisory expectations globally.

• Experience working within or leading a regional or matrixed team structure is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional cross-regional coordination and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage complex, multi-jurisdictional workstreams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to synthesise regional inputs into a coherent global strategy.

• Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.

• Ability to build trust and credibility with regulators and internal leadership.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team as Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the digital-asset industry / stablecoin industry, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
The Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations will lead the development and execution of our global authorisations strategy across key jurisdictions, working through a geographically distributed team of regional regulatory affairs and licensing teams. This role is responsible for securing and maintaining regulatory approvals required for the company’s operations, ensuring alignment with shifting regulatory landscapes, and enabling sustainable market expansion.
As a senior leader within the Regulatory Affairs & Licensing function, you will collaborate closely with regional licensing personnel, legal, compliance, product, and executive leadership to drive licensing initiatives end-to-end—from early regulatory assessments and submissions through to supervisory engagement and operational readiness. The ideal candidate brings deep multi-jurisdictional licensing expertise, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate across regions in a cohesive, consistent manner.
You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory Affairs and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory and licensing initiatives.

Responsibilities
Licensing Strategy & Execution

• Design and implement a unified global licensing strategy, ensuring consistency across regional approaches.

• Work closely with regional licensing personnel to assess regulatory pathways, evaluate market feasibility, and prioritise jurisdictions.

• Oversee and guide the preparation, submission, and management of licensing applications and / or other regulatory authorisation processes, in collaboration with regional teams.

• Ensure alignment between regional licensing efforts and global business priorities.

Regional Coordination & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the central point of coordination for licensing and regulatory authorisation activity across all regions, ensuring standards, documentation, and approaches remain cohesive.

• Provide direct support, guidance, and escalation oversight to regional licensing personnel.

• Align regulatory authorisation efforts with regulatory affairs leads to coordinate regulatory engagement strategies across regions.

Regulatory Engagement

• Act as a senior representative in regulatory engagements where global coordination or executive-level involvement is required.

• Support regional teams in interactions with local regulators, offering strategic guidance and ensuring consistent messaging.

Operational Readiness & Governance

• Coordinate with regional teams to ensure their understanding around local regulatory requirements such that they are prepared to meet jurisdictional authorisation obligations, where needed and / or desired, including governance, capital, operational, and reporting requirements.

• Maintain global oversight of regulatory authorisation conditions, ensuring local compliance is consistent with global policies and standards.

• Lead responses to cross-regional regulatory queries or supervisory reviews related to authorisation activities.

Market Expansion & Risk Analysis

• Work with regional personnel to conduct regulatory feasibility assessments for new markets and product expansions.

• Provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership on prioritisation of authorisation efforts and regulatory risk.

Team Leadership

• Lead and mentor the global regulatory and licensing team, including regional leads and supporting personnel.

• Build capability, consistency, and knowledge-sharing across regions to strengthen the company’s global licensing and authorisations function.

• Promote a culture of regulatory excellence, transparency, and disciplined execution.

Experience & Expertise

• 10+ years of experience in regulatory licensing and authorisations, regulatory affairs, compliance, or related fields (financial services, payments, fintech, crypto, or technology).

• Proven experience managing complex regulatory authorisation processes across multiple regions or markets.

• Strong understanding of diverse regulatory frameworks and supervisory expectations globally.

• Experience working within or leading a regional or matrixed team structure is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional cross-regional coordination and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage complex, multi-jurisdictional workstreams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to synthesise regional inputs into a coherent global strategy.

• Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.

• Ability to build trust and credibility with regulators and internal leadership.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives.

Responsibilities

• Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance : Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.

• Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership : Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.

• Regulatory Strategy Development : As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.

• Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development : Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.

• Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.

• Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.

• Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.

• Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.

• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
