descriptionByLocale.fr:
Joindre Tether et façonner l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises – des échanges et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets – d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques pionniers.
Mais c'est juste le début :
Tether Power: moteur de la croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisation de l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Faites partie de notre équipe de finance: L'associé opérationnel/associé principal soutiendra les opérations quotidiennes d'une plateforme d'investissement et de trésorerie multi-actifs, avec des responsabilités couvrant les opérations commerciales, les rapprochements, les flux de travail des actifs numériques et l'automatisation des processus. Ce rôle exige un individu hautement axé sur les détails, doté d'une forte capacité technique et d'une solide expérience dans des environnements de marchés financiers à rythme rapide.

Responsabilités
● Gérer les confirmations commerciales, les règlements et les événements liés au cycle de vie dans plusieurs classes d'actifs.
● Surveiller les processus opérationnels relatifs au portefeuille, au dépositaire et aux actifs numériques.
● Effectuer la réservation et le rapprochement quotidiens des positions de valeurs mobilières, des soldes de trésorerie et des P&L dans tous les systèmes internes.
∙ Enquêter sur les ruptures commerciales, les problèmes de règlement et les divergences opérationnelles avec les contreparties et les dépositaires et les résoudre.
● Appuyer les contrôles opérationnels liés aux activités de trésorerie, de négociation et d'actifs numériques.
● Aider à répondre aux demandes de vérification, aux confirmations et aux documents justificatifs.
● Préparer des rapports opérationnels quotidiens, hebdomadaires et mensuels.
● Construire, améliorer et maintenir les flux de travail opérationnels, les outils internes et les processus d'automatisation.
● Identifier les possibilités d'optimisation des processus et d'évolutivité opérationnelle.
● Créer et tenir à jour la documentation technique, les procédures et les guides d'utilisation.
● Veiller au respect des contrôles internes, des politiques et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Titres/exigences préférés :
● Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité ou domaine connexe.
● 5 ans et plus d'expérience opérationnelle de préférence dans un fonds de couverture de crédit ou une société de gestion d'actifs
● expérience dans les actifs numériques ou l'écosystème de blockchain (bien d'avoir mais pas obligatoire)
● Compétence du système de gestion de portefeuille d'Enfusion (non obligatoire)
● Compétence en Excel + VBA / Python
● Capacités exceptionnelles d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
● Excellente attention aux détails et aux compétences en communication.
● Une bonne compréhension du cycle de vie du commerce et des processus de règlement.
● Heures de travail: (heures de New York): Entre 14H00-10H00 heure du Royaume-Uni (obligatoire)

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par l'intermédiaire de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance : Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data : Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:
 The Financial Controller will oversee financial reporting, audit coordination, and accounting operations across a multi-entity investment and treasury platform. The role requires a technically strong finance professional with deep accounting expertise, strong operational discipline, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, management accounts, and supporting reports in accordance with IFRS and US GAAP.

• Manage day-to-day accounting operations across multiple entities and jurisdictions.

• Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, including general ledger reconciliations and control reviews.

• Maintain oversight of accounts payable, accounts receivable, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Lead coordination with external auditors, ensuring timely delivery of audit requests, supporting documentation, and issue resolution.

• Support preparation of any regulatory, tax, statutory and ad hoc reporting requirements.

• Strengthen and maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance frameworks.

• Drive continuous improvement across accounting processes, reporting workflows, and operational controls.

• Leverage technology and automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and reporting accuracy.

• Partner closely with operations to ensure integrity of financial data and reporting.

• Assist with implementation and optimisation of financial systems and reporting infrastructure.

• Support ad hoc financial analysis, projects, and strategic initiatives as required.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field; ACCA, ACA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent certifications.

• 10+ years of experience in financial control, audit, or accounting, preferably at a credit hedge fund. Prior experience in digital assets or blockchain ecosystems is a distinct advantage.

• Proficiency in Xero and Enfusion portfolio management system.

• Proficiency in Excel + VBA / Python is mandatory.

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong understanding of regulatory and tax requirements.

• Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT, basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Data Tether: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Informazioni sul lavoro:
Il Controllore finanziario sovrintenderà alle attività di reporting finanziario, coordinamento di audit e contabilità attraverso una piattaforma di investimento e tesoreria multi-entità. Il ruolo richiede un professionista di finanza tecnicamente forte con una profonda competenza contabile, una forte disciplina operativa, e la capacità di operare in un ambiente veloce e ad alta crescita.

• Preparare dichiarazioni finanziarie accurate e tempestive, conti di gestione e rapporti di supporto in conformità con IFRS e US GAAP.

• Gestisci operazioni contabili quotidiane in più enti e giurisdizioni.

• Superare i processi di fine mese, fine trimestre e fine anno, tra cui le conciliazioni generali di registro e le recensioni di controllo.

• Mantenere la supervisione dei conti pagabili, crediti di conti, accruamenti e riconciliazioni del bilancio.

• Coordinamento di piombo con i revisori esterni, garantendo la consegna tempestiva delle richieste di audit, la documentazione di supporto e la risoluzione dei problemi.

• Preparazione del supporto di eventuali requisiti normativi, fiscali, legali e di reporting ad hoc.

• Rafforzare e mantenere i controlli interni, le politiche contabili e i quadri di governance finanziaria.

• Miglioramento continuo dei processi contabili, dei flussi di lavoro di reporting e dei controlli operativi.

• Leva la tecnologia e l'automazione per migliorare l'efficienza, la scalabilità e la precisione di reporting.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con le operazioni per garantire l'integrità dei dati finanziari e la reportistica.

• Assistere con implementazione e ottimizzazione dei sistemi finanziari e delle infrastrutture di reporting.

• Sostegno ad hoc analisi finanziaria, progetti e iniziative strategiche come richiesto.

Qualificazioni & Esperienza:

• Laurea in contabilità, finanza, o un campo correlato; ACCA, ACA, CPA, CFA, o certificazioni equivalenti.

• 10+ anni di esperienza nel controllo finanziario, audit o contabilità, preferibilmente in un fondo di copertura di credito. L'esperienza precedente nei beni digitali o negli ecosistemi blockchain è un vantaggio distinto.

• La competenza nel sistema di gestione del portafoglio Xero e Enfusion.

• La competenza in Excel + VBA / Python è obbligatoria.

• Eccezionale capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• Forte comprensione dei requisiti normativi e fiscali.

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di comunicazione.

Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data : Alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education: Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous habilitons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

À propos du travail :
Le contrôleur financier supervisera l'information financière, la coordination des audits et les opérations comptables dans le cadre d'une plateforme d'investissement et de trésorerie multientités. Le rôle exige un professionnel de la finance techniquement solide, doté d'une solide expertise comptable, d'une discipline opérationnelle solide et d'une capacité d'opérer dans un environnement à forte croissance rapide.

• Préparer en temps voulu des états financiers exacts, des comptes de gestion et des rapports justificatifs conformément aux IFRS et aux PCGR des États-Unis.

• Gérer les opérations comptables courantes dans plusieurs entités et administrations.

• Surveiller les processus de fin de mois, de fin de trimestre et de clôture de fin d'exercice, y compris les rapprochements du grand livre général et les examens de contrôle.

• Surveiller les créditeurs, les débiteurs, les charges à payer et les rapprochements de bilan.

• Diriger la coordination avec les vérificateurs externes, assurer la livraison en temps opportun des demandes de vérification, la documentation à l'appui et la résolution des problèmes.

• Appuyer la préparation de toute exigence de déclaration réglementaire, fiscale, législative et ad hoc.

• Renforcer et maintenir les contrôles internes, les politiques comptables et les cadres de gouvernance financière.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus comptables, des flux de travail et des contrôles opérationnels.

• Tirer parti de la technologie et de l'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité, l'évolutivité et la précision des rapports.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les opérations afin d'assurer l'intégrité des données et des rapports financiers.

• Aider à la mise en œuvre et à l'optimisation des systèmes financiers et de l'infrastructure de rapport.

• Appuyer l'analyse financière, les projets et les initiatives stratégiques au besoin.

Qualifications et expérience :

• Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finance ou un domaine connexe; certifications ACCA, ACA, CPA, CFA ou équivalent.

• 10 ans d'expérience en contrôle financier, audit ou comptabilité, de préférence dans un fonds de couverture de crédit. L'expérience antérieure en matière d'actifs numériques ou d'écosystèmes de blockchain est un avantage distinct.

• Compétence en gestion de portefeuille Xero et Enfusion.

• La compétence en Excel + VBA / Python est obligatoire.

• Capacités exceptionnelles d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Une bonne compréhension des exigences réglementaires et fiscales.

• Excellente attention aux détails et compétences en communication.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We're hiring a UX Researcher to work horizontally across Tether's full product portfolio from consumer apps like Keet, QVAC Workbench, and the Tether Wallet, to the developer portals and platforms behind QVAC, Pears, MDK, and WDK.
 This isn't a typical UX research role. The breadth is the point: one week you're studying how someone in Lagos uses USDt on their phone, the next you're sitting with engineers to figure out the best practice of developer portals. We need someone with genuine curiosity, depth of thinking, and the ability to communicate findings clearly enough that product designers and product managers make better decisions because of them. The goal is simple and never changes: the best possible experience for the user.

Responsibilities

• Run UX research across Tether's consumer and developer products: Keet, QVAC Workbench, Tether Wallet, developer portals, and more

• Identify UX best practices and emerging patterns across each product category

• Research competitors and adjacent products to surface how others are solving comparable problems, and where the gaps are

• Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product designers and product managers

• Partner with product teams across all four pillars (Stable Finance, Stable Intelligence, Stable Power, Stable Communications) to inform decisions at every stage of the product lifecycle

• Build and maintain a research repository so insights compound over time and are reusable across teams

• Tailor methods to each product qualitative, quantitative, lightweight, deep whatever the question actually needs

• 5+ years of UX research experience across consumer and/or developer products

• End-to-end research chops: defining the question, picking the method, executing, synthesizing, and communicating outcomes

• Strong command of qualitative methods (interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry) and working familiarity with quantitative ones

• Working knowledge of at least one of: crypto wallets and self-custody, messaging or P2P, AI applications, or developer tooling

• Sharp written and verbal communication — able to convert ambiguous findings into decision-ready recommendations

• Experience with products where trust, privacy, security, money movement, or technical complexity affect the user experience.

• Mandatory AI fluency: you must actively use AI tools to speed up research planning, synthesis, insight mapping, documentation, and reporting, while applying strong human judgement.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to convert messy findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership.

• Strong product judgement: able to separate signal from noise and identify which insights should influence the product.

• Comfortable working in fast-moving environments where research needs to be practical, focused, and useful.

• Genuine curiosity, critical thinking, and depth of analysis that goes beyond surface-level observations.

• Low-ego collaboration style, with the ability to challenge assumptions clearly and constructively.

• Genuine curiosity and depth of thinking that goes beyond surface-level observations

Bonus points:

• Background researching developer audiences and developer experience specifically

• Experience setting up UX research practices from scratch or scaling them across multiple product teams

• Background in fintech, crypto, AI, P2P, or open-source ecosystems

• Familiarity with privacy-preserving research methods

• Ability to create low-fidelity prototypes to demonstrate and inspire potential user flow , functionality and content structure improvements

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. The role oversees the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple interrelated mining projects: spanning exploration, development, operations readiness, stakeholder engagement, and institutional relations and also ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and local community expectations.

Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.

• Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.

• Manage relationships with government authorities, regulators, and local institutions to advance permits, concessions, and policy engagement.

• Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.

• Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.

• Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.

• Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.

• Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.

• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.

• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.

• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.

• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.

• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.

• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.

• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Prior experience operating in Central America.

• Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.

• Experience interacting with public-sector counterparts and multilateral institutions.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
We are looking for a highly organized and culturally agile Expansion Events Coordinator to drive the physical presence of our Expansion Team. In this role you will be the operational backbone for our international growth, serving as a critical partner to our Expansion Managers in each country.
You will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end execution of a diverse event portfolio, ranging from conferences, workshops, summits and brand sponsorships to large-scale international conferences. Notably, you will provide direct support for the department, ensuring these world-class gatherings are executed with precision.

Responsibilities

• End-to-End Execution: Lead the coordination of international events from initial concept and booth design through to on-site execution and post-event reporting.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between global venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery.

• Logistics & Operations : Master the "fine print" by managing complex calendars, scheduling cross-functional meetings, overseeing intricate travel, event logistics, Finance & Budget coordination.

• Financial Oversight : Support the Expansion Team with budget reconciliation, expense tracking, and detailed performance reporting.

• Internal Logistics : Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate travel logistics.

• Global Communication : Manage both internal and external communications, ensuring the brand voice is consistent across English and Spanish-speaking markets.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Event Management or Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality & Tourism Management

• A willingness and availability to travel when required.

• Experience: 5+ years of proven success in global corporate events or the professional event industry.

• Linguistic Versatility: Native or full professional proficiency in English and Spanish is required. (Bonus points if you speak Italian).

• Tech-Savviness: Advanced proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office, with the ability to quickly adopt new project management tools.

• A solid grasp of budgeting, invoicing, and expense management.

• Adaptability: A "no task too big or small" mindset, comfortable moving from high-level sponsorship strategy to the ground-level execution.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 At Tether, we're building Hadron , the enterprise tokenization platform powering the next generation of tokenized assets, stablecoins, securities, funds, commodities, and real-world assets (RWAs).
 Hadron enables financial institutions, asset managers, exchanges, governments, and enterprises to issue, manage, and operate regulated digital assets across multiple blockchain networks while integrating compliance, permissions, and operational workflows.
 We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the core infrastructure behind Hadron. You will work on tokenization engines, blockchain integrations, permissions frameworks, issuance workflows, compliance tooling, and enterprise APIs used by institutional clients worldwide.
 This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges at the intersection of blockchain, financial infrastructure, and enterprise software.

Responsibilities
 Tokenization Platform Development

• Design, build, and maintain the backend services powering Hadron's tokenization platform

• Develop APIs supporting asset issuance, lifecycle management, corporate actions, and token operations

• Build scalable infrastructure for institutional-grade tokenization workflows

• Contribute to the evolution of Hadron's architecture and core platform capabilities

Blockchain Infrastructure

• Build integrations with Ethereum, EVM-compatible chains, and other supported blockchain networks

• Develop services handling token minting, burning, transfers, permissions, and administrative operations

• Improve blockchain transaction orchestration, signing workflows, and operational reliability

• Contribute to smart contract integrations and blockchain infrastructure

Enterprise Infrastructure

• Build systems supporting role-based permissions, multi-signature approvals, auditability, and operational controls

• Develop integrations with custody providers, identity providers, and compliance services

• Improve scalability, observability, monitoring, and platform reliability

• Support deployment automation and operational tooling

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Solutions teams

• Translate institutional client requirements into scalable platform capabilities

• Participate in architecture reviews and technical planning

• Contribute to documentation and engineering best practices

Core Skills

• 5+ years of backend software engineering experience

• Strong expertise in Node.js (primary technology stack)

• Experience designing scalable APIs and distributed backend systems

• Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, microservices, and asynchronous systems

• Experience with relational and NoSQL databases

• Strong debugging, performance optimization, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent English communication skills

Blockchain & Digital Assets

• Experience building blockchain-based applications or infrastructure

• Strong understanding of Ethereum and EVM ecosystems

• Experience interacting with smart contracts and blockchain transaction workflows

• Understanding of wallet architecture, signing flows, and digital asset infrastructure

• Familiarity with token standards such as ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 or security token standards

Nice to Have

• Experience with tokenization platforms or issuance infrastructure

• Familiarity with token standards such as ERC-1400, transfer restrictions, permissions models, and whitelist frameworks

• Experience with institutional digital assets, custody providers, or regulated financial infrastructure

• Experience integrating KYC/AML providers and compliance workflows

• Familiarity with capital markets, securities, funds, stablecoins, or real-world asset tokenization

• Experience working in remote-first engineering organizations

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
A Tether, stiamo costruendo Hadron , la piattaforma di tokenizzazione aziendale che alimenta la prossima generazione di beni tokenizzati, stalloni, titoli, fondi, materie prime e beni del mondo reale (RWAs).
Hadron consente alle istituzioni finanziarie, agli asset manager, agli scambi, ai governi e alle imprese di emettere, gestire e gestire attività digitali regolamentate in più reti blockchain, integrando la conformità, le autorizzazioni e i flussi di lavoro operativi.
Stiamo cercando un Senior Software Engineer per contribuire a costruire l'infrastruttura di base dietro Hadron. Si lavorerà sui motori di tokenizzazione, le integrazioni blockchain, i quadri di autorizzazioni, i flussi di lavoro di emissione, gli strumenti di conformità e le API aziendali utilizzate da clienti istituzionali in tutto il mondo.
Questo è un ruolo ingegneristico pratico per qualcuno che gode di risolvere complesse sfide di sistemi distribuiti all'incrocio di blockchain, infrastrutture finanziarie e software aziendale.

responsabilità
Tokenizzazione piattaforma di sviluppo

• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione dei servizi di backend che alimentano la piattaforma di tokenizzazione di Hadron

• Sviluppare API che supportano l'emissione di asset, la gestione del ciclo di vita, le azioni aziendali e le operazioni di token

• Costruisci infrastrutture scalabili per flussi di lavoro di tokenizzazione istituzionali

• Contribuisci all'evoluzione delle capacità di architettura e piattaforma core di Hadron

Infrastrutture Blockchain

• Costruire integrazioni con catene compatibili Ethereum, EVM e altre reti blockchain supportate

• Sviluppare servizi di gestione token minting, masterizzazione, trasferimenti, autorizzazioni e operazioni amministrative

• Migliora l'orchestrazione delle transazioni blockchain, la firma dei flussi di lavoro e l'affidabilità operativa

• Contribuisci alle integrazioni dei contratti intelligenti e alle infrastrutture blockchain

Infrastrutture di impresa

• Costruire sistemi che supportano autorizzazioni basate sul ruolo, approvazioni multi-firma, verificabilità e controlli operativi

• Sviluppare integrazioni con fornitori di custodia, fornitori di identità e servizi di conformità

• Migliora la scalabilità, l'osservanza, il monitoraggio e l'affidabilità della piattaforma

• Automazione e strumenti operativi di supporto

Collaborazione trasversale

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di prodotto, ingegneria, conformità e soluzioni

• Tradurre i requisiti dei clienti istituzionali in capacità di piattaforma scalabili

• Partecipa a recensioni di architettura e pianificazione tecnica

• Contribuire alla documentazione e alle best practice di ingegneria

Competenze

• 5+ anni di esperienza di ingegneria del software backend

• Forte competenza in Node.js ( stack di tecnologia primaria)

• Esperienza nella progettazione di API scalabili e sistemi backend distribuiti

• Forte comprensione di architetture cloud-native, microservizi e sistemi asincrono

• Esperienza con database relazionali e NoSQL

• Forte debug, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e capacità di problem solving

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione inglese

Blockchain & Digital Assets

• Esperienza costruzione blockchain applicazioni o infrastrutture

• Forte comprensione degli ecosistemi Ethereum e EVM

• Esperienza che interagisce con contratti intelligenti e flussi di transazioni blockchain

• Comprensione dell'architettura del portafoglio, dei flussi di firma e delle infrastrutture di asset digitali

• Familiarità con gli standard di token come ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 o standard di token di sicurezza

Bello da avere

• Esperienza con piattaforme di tokenizzazione o infrastrutture di emissione

• Familiarità con standard di token come ERC-1400, restrizioni di trasferimento, modelli di autorizzazioni e framework whitelist

• Esperienza con risorse digitali istituzionali, fornitori di custodia o infrastrutture finanziarie regolamentate

• Esperienza di integrazione dei fornitori KYC/AML e dei flussi di lavoro di conformità

• Familiarità con i mercati dei capitali, i titoli, i fondi, i fondi stabili o la tokenizzazione degli asset nel mondo reale

• Esperienza di lavoro in organizzazioni di ingegneria remote

Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen, die nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben, optimieren überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in hochmodernen, geodiversen Anlagen.
Tether Data: Durch die Förderung von Durchbrüchen in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert.
Tether Education: Indem wir den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen demokratisieren, befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaften zu gedeihen und das globale Wachstum und die Chancen zu fördern.
Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus der Ferne aus allen Ecken der Welt arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Bei Tether bauen wir Hadron, die Enterprise-Tokenisierungsplattform, die die nächste Generation von tokenisierten Assets, Stablecoins, Wertpapieren, Fonds, Rohstoffen und Real-World-Assets (RWAs) unterstützt.
Hadron ermöglicht es Finanzinstituten, Vermögensverwaltern, Börsen, Regierungen und Unternehmen, regulierte digitale Vermögenswerte in mehreren Blockchain-Netzwerken auszugeben, zu verwalten und zu betreiben, während Compliance, Berechtigungen und operative Workflows integriert werden.
Wir suchen einen Senior Software Engineer, der beim Aufbau der Kerninfrastruktur hinter Hadron hilft. Sie werden an Tokenisierungs-Engines, Blockchain-Integrationen, Berechtigungs-Frameworks, Emissions-Workflows, Compliance-Tools und Unternehmens-APIs arbeiten, die von institutionellen Kunden weltweit verwendet werden.
Dies ist eine praktische Engineering-Rolle für jemanden, der es genießt, komplexe Herausforderungen verteilter Systeme an der Schnittstelle von Blockchain, Finanzinfrastruktur und Unternehmenssoftware zu lösen.

Zuständigkeiten
Tokenisierungsplattformentwicklung

• Design, Build und Wartung der Backend-Services für die Tokenisierungsplattform von Hadron

• APIs zur Unterstützung von Asset Emission, Lifecycle Management, Corporate Actions und Token Operations entwickeln

• Aufbau einer skalierbaren Infrastruktur für institutionelle Tokenisierungs-Workflows

• Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Architektur und Kernplattformfähigkeiten von Hadron

Blockchain-Infrastruktur

• Aufbau von Integrationen mit Ethereum, EVM-kompatiblen Ketten und anderen unterstützten Blockchain-Netzwerken

• Entwickeln von Diensten für die Verarbeitung von Token Minting, Burning, Transfers, Berechtigungen und administrativen Vorgängen

• Verbesserung der Blockchain-Transaktionsorchestrierung, der Signatur von Workflows und der Betriebszuverlässigkeit

• Beitrag zu intelligenten Vertragsintegrationen und Blockchain-Infrastruktur

Unternehmensinfrastruktur

• Erstellen von Systemen, die rollenbasierte Berechtigungen, Genehmigungen für mehrere Signaturen, Auditierbarkeit und Betriebskontrollen unterstützen

• Integrationen mit Depotanbietern, Identitätsanbietern und Compliance-Diensten entwickeln

• Verbesserung der Skalierbarkeit, Beobachtbarkeit, Überwachung und Plattformzuverlässigkeit

• Unterstützung von Deployment Automation und Operational Tooling

Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produkt-, Engineering-, Compliance- und Lösungsteams

• Übersetzen institutioneller Kundenanforderungen in skalierbare Plattformfunktionen

• Beteiligen Sie sich an Architekturprüfungen und technischer Planung

• Beitrag zu Best Practices für Dokumentation und Engineering

Kernkompetenzen

• 5+ Jahre Backend Software Engineering Erfahrung

• Starke Expertise in Node.js (Primärtechnologie-Stack)

• Erleben Sie skalierbare APIs und verteilte Backend-Systeme

• Starkes Verständnis von Cloud-nativen Architekturen, Microservices und asynchronen Systemen

• Erfahrung mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken

• Starkes Debugging, Performance Optimierung und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

• Ausgezeichnete Englisch Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Blockchain & Digital Assets

• Erleben Sie den Aufbau von Blockchain-basierten Anwendungen oder Infrastrukturen

• Starkes Verständnis von Ethereum und EVM-Ökosystemen

• Erfahrung in der Interaktion mit Smart Contracts und Blockchain-Transaktions-Workflows

• Verständnis der Wallet-Architektur, Signing-Flows und Digital Asset Infrastruktur

• Vertrautheit mit Token-Standards wie ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 oder Security-Token-Standards

Nizza zu haben

• Erfahrung mit Tokenisierungsplattformen oder Emissionsinfrastruktur

• Vertrautheit mit Token-Standards wie ERC-1400, Übertragungsbeschränkungen, Berechtigungsmodellen und Whitelist-Frameworks

• Erfahrung mit institutionellen digitalen Assets, Depotanbietern oder regulierter Finanzinfrastruktur

• Erfahrung in der Integration von KYC/AML-Anbietern und Compliance-Workflows

• Vertrautheit mit Kapitalmärkten, Wertpapieren, Fonds, Stablecoins oder Real-World Asset Tokenization

• Erfahrung in Remote First Engineering-Organisationen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début:
Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Chez Tether, nous construisons Hadron , la plate-forme de tokenisation d'entreprise qui alimente la prochaine génération d'actifs tokenisés, de monnaies stables, de titres, de fonds, de matières premières et d'actifs du monde réel (RWA).
Hadron permet aux institutions financières, aux gestionnaires d'actifs, aux bourses, aux gouvernements et aux entreprises d'émettre, de gérer et d'exploiter des actifs numériques réglementés sur plusieurs réseaux de blockchain tout en intégrant la conformité, les autorisations et les workflows opérationnels.
Nous cherchons un ingénieur logiciel senior pour aider à construire l'infrastructure de base derrière Hadron. Vous travaillerez sur les moteurs de tokenisation, les intégrations de blockchain, les cadres de permission, les workflows d'émission, l'outillage de conformité et les API d'entreprise utilisées par les clients institutionnels dans le monde entier.
Il s'agit d'un rôle d'ingénierie pratique pour quelqu'un qui aime résoudre des problèmes complexes de systèmes distribués à l'intersection de la blockchain, de l'infrastructure financière et des logiciels d'entreprise.

Responsabilités
Développement de la plate-forme de tokenisation

• Concevoir, construire et maintenir les services de moteur d'alimentation de la plateforme de tokenisation d'Hadron

• Élaborer des IPA à l'appui de l'émission d'actifs, de la gestion du cycle de vie, des mesures ministérielles et des opérations de jeton

• Bâtir une infrastructure évolutive pour les processus de tokenisation de qualité institutionnelle

• Contribuer à l'évolution de l'architecture d'Hadron et des capacités de la plate-forme centrale

Infrastructure de la chaîne de blocs

• Construire des intégrations avec Ethereum, les chaînes compatibles EVM et d'autres réseaux de blockchain pris en charge

• Mettre au point des services de manutention de jetons, de gravure, de transfert, de permission et d'opérations administratives

• Améliorer l'orchestration des transactions de blockchain, la signature des workflows et la fiabilité opérationnelle

• Contribuer aux intégrations de contrats intelligents et aux infrastructures de blockchain

Infrastructure des entreprises

• Élaborer des systèmes qui appuient les autorisations fondées sur le rôle, les approbations multisignatures, la vérification et les contrôles opérationnels

• Élaborer des intégrations avec les fournisseurs de garde, les fournisseurs d'identité et les services de conformité

• Améliorer l'évolutivité, l'observation, la surveillance et la fiabilité de la plateforme

• Automatisation du déploiement de l ' appui et outillage opérationnel

Collaboration interfonctionnelle

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produits, Ingénierie, Conformité et Solutions

• Traduire les besoins des clients institutionnels en capacités de plate-forme évolutives

• Participer aux examens d'architecture et à la planification technique

• Contribuer à la documentation et aux meilleures pratiques techniques

Compétences de base

• 5 ans et plus d'expérience en génie logiciel

• Forte expertise en Node.js (pile de technologie primaire)

• Expérience de conception d'API évolutive et de systèmes de backend distribués

• Une bonne compréhension des architectures cloud-natives, des microservices et des systèmes asynchrones

• Expérience des bases de données relationnelles et NoSQL

• Forte capacité de débogage, d'optimisation des performances et de résolution de problèmes

• Excellentes compétences de communication en anglais

Blockchain & Actifs numériques

• Expérience de la construction d'applications ou d'infrastructures basées sur la blockchain

• Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de l'Ethereum et du VEM

• Expérience en interaction avec les contrats intelligents et les flux de transactions de blockchain

• Compréhension de l'architecture du portefeuille, des flux de signature et de l'infrastructure des actifs numériques

• Connaissance des normes de jeton telles que ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 ou des normes de jeton de sécurité

Sympa d'avoir

• Expérience des plateformes de tokenisation ou de l'infrastructure d'émission

• Connaissance des normes de jeton telles que ERC-1400, restrictions de transfert, modèles de permissions et cadres de listes blanches

• Expérience des actifs numériques institutionnels, des fournisseurs de garde ou de l'infrastructure financière réglementée

• Expérience de l'intégration des fournisseurs KYC/AML et des flux de travail de conformité

• Familiarisation avec les marchés de capitaux, les valeurs mobilières, les fonds, les monnaies stables ou les actifs du monde réel

• Expérience de travail dans des organismes d'ingénierie à distance

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices.

Native module development

• Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests

• Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript

• Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list

Cross-platform builds and CI

• Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode)

• Own cross-compilation toolchain configuration for each target platform

• Maintain CI pipelines that build and test native modules across all supported platforms

• Investigate and fix platform-specific build failures and toolchain issues

Bare Runtime contributions

• Contribute to the Bare runtime core (module system, native addon system, light-weight threads)

• Help reduce the bare-node missing API surface

• Participate in evaluating and integrating alternative JS engines eg libjerry

Debugging and quality

• Debug native addon issues across multiple OS and device targets, including mobile

• Write and maintain tests for all modules

Collaboration and communication

• Respond to Bare team inquiries from internal teams and the public.

• Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions in writing .

• Participate in a weekly status call.

• Participate in Bare workshops and contribute to onboarding materials.

• Coordinate with product teams (Keet, WDK/Wallet).

• Strong C programming skills, including experience writing and debugging native code across platforms.

• Advanced JavaScript skills with a solid understanding of Node.js internals and the module ecosystem.

• Experience building native addons for Node.js or similar runtimes (N-API, node-gyp, or equivalent).

• Familiarity with libuv or other asynchronous I/O frameworks.

• Comfortable working across macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS build toolchains.

• Experience with cross-compilation and platform-specific system APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem).

• Ability to read and navigate large C and C++ codebases.

• Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Why Join Us?

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in architecture development for cutting-edge models of various scales, including small, large, and multi-modal systems. Your work will enhance intelligence, improve efficiency, and introduce new capabilities to advance the field.
 You will have a deep expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) and Multi-Modal architectures, a strong grasp of pre-training optimization, and a hands-on, research-driven approach. Your mission is to explore and implement novel techniques and algorithms that lead to groundbreaking advancements: multi-modal data curation and alignment, strengthening baselines, and identifying and resolving existing pre-training bottlenecks to push the limits of cross-modal AI performance.

Responsibilities

• Large-Scale Pre-Training: Conduct foundational pre-training for LLMs and Multi-Modal models (integrating text, vision, audio, or other modalities) on large, distributed servers equipped with multi-nodes & thousands of NVIDIA GPUs.

• Architecture & Alignment Innovation: Design, prototype, and scale innovative architectures, tokenizers, and cross-modal alignment layers to enhance model intelligence and multi-modal understanding.

• Data Strategy: Source, filter, and curate massive-scale textual and multi-modal datasets, establishing robust data pipelines for efficient pre-training.

• Experimental Research: Independently and collaboratively execute experiments, analyze results, and refine training methodologies for optimal performance and token efficiency.

• Optimization & Debugging: Investigate, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks in model efficiency, computational performance, and multi-modal alignment stability during long training runs.

• System Scalability: Contribute to the advancement of distributed training systems to ensure seamless scalability and hardware efficiency on target platforms.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Hands-on experience contributing to large-scale LLM or Multi-Modal pre-training runs on large, distributed servers equipped with thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, ensuring scalability and impactful advancements in model performance.

• Familiarity and practical experience with large-scale, distributed training frameworks, libraries and tools.

• Deep knowledge of state-of-the-art transformer and non-transformer modifications aimed at enhancing intelligence, efficiency and scalability.

• Strong expertise in PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries with practical experience in model development, continual pretraining, and deployment.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere i gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali pionieristici.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Come membro del team di modelli AI, guiderai l'innovazione nello sviluppo dell'architettura per modelli all'avanguardia di varie scale, tra cui piccoli, grandi e sistemi multi-modali. Il vostro lavoro aumenterà l'intelligenza, migliorerà l'efficienza e introdurrà nuove capacità per far progredire il campo.
Avrai una profonda esperienza nelle architetture di Large Language Model (LLM) e Multi-Modal, una forte presa di ottimizzazione pre-formazione e un approccio pratico e ricercato. La vostra missione è di esplorare e implementare nuove tecniche e algoritmi che portano a progressi innovativi: la cura e l'allineamento dei dati multi-modali, il rafforzamento delle linee di base, e l'identificazione e la risoluzione dei colli di bottiglia pre-training esistenti per spingere i limiti delle prestazioni AI cross-modal.

responsabilità

• Pre-Training a grande scala: Condurre pre-training fondazionale per modelli LLM e Multi-Modal (integrazione di testo, visione, audio o altre modalità) su server di grandi dimensioni e distribuiti dotati di multi-nodi e migliaia di GPU NVIDIA.

• Architettura e allineamento Innovazione: Design, prototipo e scala architetture innovative, tokenizzatori e strati cross-modali per migliorare l'intelligenza del modello e la comprensione multi-modale.

• Strategia dei dati: Sorgente, filtro e cura dei set di dati testuali e multimodali su vasta scala, stabilendo robusti pipeline di dati per una pre-formazione efficiente.

• Ricerca sperimentale: Indipendentemente e collaborativamente eseguire esperimenti, analizzare i risultati e perfezionare metodologie di formazione per prestazioni ottimali e l'efficienza dei gettoni.

• Ottimizzazione & Debugging: Investigare, debug ed eliminare strozzature nell'efficienza del modello, nelle prestazioni computazionali e nella stabilità dell'allineamento multimodale durante i lunghi allenamenti.

• Scalabilità del sistema: Contribuisci all'avanzamento dei sistemi di formazione distribuiti per garantire una scalabilità senza soluzione di continuità e l'efficienza hardware sulle piattaforme di destinazione.

• Una laurea in Informatica o campo correlato. Idealmente PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, o in un campo correlato, completato da un solido track record in AI R&D (con buone pubblicazioni in conferenze A*).

• Esperienza pratica che contribuisce alla pre-formazione su larga scala LLM o Multi-Modal su server di grandi dimensioni e distribuiti dotati di migliaia di GPU NVIDIA, garantendo scalabilità e progressi impeccabili nelle prestazioni del modello.

• Familiarità e esperienza pratica con quadri di formazione distribuiti su larga scala, biblioteche e strumenti.

• Conoscenza profonda delle modifiche di trasformatori e non-trasformatori all'avanguardia finalizzate a migliorare l'intelligenza, l'efficienza e la scalabilità.

• Forte esperienza nelle librerie PyTorch e Hugging Face con esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di modelli, preformazione continua e distribuzione.

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione avviene tramite e-mail e piattaforme ufficiali.

• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalarlo immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
