About the job
 Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.

• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.

• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.

• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.

• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.

• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.

• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.

• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.

• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.

• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).

• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.

• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).

• Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.

• Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites.

About the job
Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.

• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.

• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.

• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.

• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.

• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.

• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.

• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.

• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.

• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).

• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.

• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).

• Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.

• Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 We are seeking a Technical Content Creator to showcase the practical power of Tether's peer-to-peer stack. This is a builder-centric role designed for an engineer or highly technical creator who bridges the gap between low-level infrastructure, cryptography, and functional application.

We are not looking for a social media marketer or an on-camera influencer. We are looking for a technical storyteller who can write code, spin up peer-to-peer nodes, build functional Bare-powered applications, and record polished, clear, screen-share demos. You will turn our core stack (Pear and Bare) into an ongoing series of visual, practical "build-in-public" prototypes that prove to the world what true decentralized, peer-to-peer infrastructure looks like.

Responsibilities

• Build Practical Demos: Independently build functional peer-to-peer applications and infrastructure setups using the Pear platform and the Bare runtime with minimal engineering hand-holding.

• Record Technical Demos: Record clear, engaging, and high-quality screen-share walkthroughs and video demos of your builds, highlighting how the code works, how peers discover and sync with each other, and the value the systems deliver.

• Translate Code to Content: Turn complex protocol updates, cryptographic primitives, and technical documentation into highly visual, digestible developer content (such as code-along videos, step-by-step guides, and interactive repositories).

• Collaborate with Core Devs: Work closely with our P2P protocol and product engineering teams to stay ahead of upcoming Pear and Bare features.

• Prototypes: Rapidly prototype application concepts — such as spinning up a peer-to-peer chat, file-sync, or data-replication demo — to show how quickly developers can launch resilient, serverless products using our ecosystem.

• Fuel Influencer-Led Developer Adoption: Collaborate with technical influencers, developer advocates, and content creators to amplify our ecosystem. You will provide them with turn-key technical assets, co-create code-along challenges, and arm them with the high-quality demos and prototypes needed to inspire and onboard new developers to Pear and Bare.

• 3 to 6+ years of experience in a technical role such as Technical Content Creation, Solutions Engineering, or Backend/Systems Development.

• Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in languages used across our ecosystem (such as NodeJS, C/C++) to interact confidently with peer-to-peer networking and runtime internals.

• Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of peer-to-peer (P2P) networking, distributed systems, hypercore/append-only-log style data structures, and decentralized application architecture.

• Demo/Video Production Skills: Experience recording and editing polished technical screen-shares, terminal recordings, or video tutorials (using tools like Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow, etc.).

• Developer Empathy: The ability to look at a complex P2P protocol or runtime and understand exactly what kind of demo or sample project will get developers and infrastructure operators excited to start building.

• Self-Starter Mindset: Comfortable working autonomously in a remote, distributed environment across global time zones.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali pionieristici.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Stiamo cercando un Creatore di Contenuto Tecnico per mostrare la potenza pratica dello stack peer-to-peer di Tether. Questo è un ruolo costruttivo-centrico progettato per un ingegnere o creatore altamente tecnico che colma il divario tra infrastrutture di basso livello, crittografia e applicazione funzionale.

Non stiamo cercando un social media marketer o un influencer on-camera. Stiamo cercando un storyteller tecnico che può scrivere codice, girare i nodi peer-to-peer, costruire applicazioni funzionali Bare-powered, e registrare demo lucido, chiaro, schermo-share. Si trasformerà il nostro stack core (Pear and Bare) in una serie continua di prototipi visuali e pratici "build-in-public" che dimostrano al mondo come la vera infrastruttura decentrata, peer-to-peer sembra.

responsabilità

• Creare Demo Pratiche: costruire in modo indipendente applicazioni funzionali peer-to-peer e configurazioni infrastrutturali utilizzando la piattaforma Pear e il runtime Bare con minimo ingegneria hand-holding.

• Record Technical Demos: Registra cammini trasparenti, coinvolgenti e di alta qualità con schermo-share e demo video delle tue costruzioni, evidenziando come funziona il codice, come i coetanei scoprono e si sincronizzano tra loro, e il valore che i sistemi offrono.

• Traduci Code to Content: Trasforma gli aggiornamenti complessi del protocollo, i primitivi crittografici e la documentazione tecnica in contenuti di sviluppo altamente visivi e digeribili (come video code-along, guide passo-passo e repository interattivi).

• Collabora con Core Devs: Lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri team di protocollo P2P e di ingegneria dei prodotti per rimanere in vista delle prossime caratteristiche di Pear e Bare.

• Prototipi: Prototipi rapidi prototipi di concetti di applicazione, come la filatura di una chat peer-to-peer, la sincronizzazione dei file o la demo di risposta ai dati, per mostrare come rapidamente gli sviluppatori possono lanciare prodotti resilienti, serverless utilizzando il nostro ecosistema.

• Adottare lo sviluppatore Led: collaborare con gli influencer tecnici, i sostenitori dello sviluppatore e i creatori di contenuti per amplificare il nostro ecosistema. Fornirai loro risorse tecniche chiavi in mano, sfide co-create code-along, e li arma con le demo e i prototipi di alta qualità necessari per ispirare e a bordo nuovi sviluppatori a Pear e Bare.

• Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza in un ruolo tecnico come Creazione di contenuti tecnici, Ingegneria delle soluzioni, o Backend/Systems Development.

• Forti competenze di programmazione: competenza nelle lingue utilizzate in tutto il nostro ecosistema (come NodeJS, C/C++) per interagire con fiducia con la rete peer-to-peer e gli interni runtime.

• Competenza di dominio: comprensione solida della rete peer-to-peer (P2P), sistemi distribuiti, strutture di dati di stile ipercore/append-only-log e architettura di applicazioni decentrate.

• Abilità di produzione Demo/Video: Registrazione e modifica di schermi tecnici lucidati, registrazioni terminali o tutorial video (utilizzando strumenti come Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow, ecc.).

• Sviluppatore Empathy: La capacità di guardare un protocollo P2P complesso o runtime e capire esattamente che tipo di progetto demo o campione otterrà sviluppatori e operatori di infrastrutture entusiasta di iniziare la costruzione.

• Self-Starter Mindset: Confortevole lavoro autonomo in un ambiente remoto e distribuito in aree temporali globali.

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggere se stessi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione avviene tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.

• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalarlo immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

Tether Data: Durch die Förderung von Durchbrüchen in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert.
Tether Education: Indem wir den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen demokratisieren, befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaften zu gedeihen und das globale Wachstum und die Chancen zu fördern.
Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus allen Ecken der Welt fern arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Wir suchen einen Technical Content Creator, um die praktische Leistung des Peer-to-Peer-Stacks von Tether zu präsentieren. Dies ist eine Builder-zentrierte Rolle für einen Ingenieur oder hochtechnischen Schöpfer, der die Lücke zwischen Low-Level-Infrastruktur, Kryptographie und funktionaler Anwendung schließt.

Wir suchen keinen Social Media Marketer oder einen On-Kamera Influencer. Wir suchen nach einem technischen Storyteller, der Code schreiben, Peer-to-Peer-Knoten drehen, funktionale Bare-basierte Anwendungen erstellen und polierte, klare Screen-Share-Demos aufnehmen kann. Sie werden unseren Kernstapel (Pear and Bare) in eine fortlaufende Reihe visueller, praktischer "Build-in-Public" -Prototypen verwandeln, die der Welt beweisen, wie eine echte dezentrale Peer-to-Peer-Infrastruktur aussieht.

Zuständigkeiten

• Erstellen Sie praktische Demos: Erstellen Sie selbstständig funktionale Peer-to-Peer-Anwendungen und Infrastruktur-Setups mit der Pear-Plattform und der Bare-Laufzeit mit minimalem Engineering-Handhalten.

• Zeichnen Sie technische Demos auf: Zeichnen Sie klare, ansprechende und qualitativ hochwertige Screen-Sharing-Begehungen und Video-Demos Ihrer Builds auf und heben Sie hervor, wie der Code funktioniert, wie Peers miteinander entdecken und synchronisieren und welchen Wert die Systeme bieten.

• Code in Inhalt übersetzen: Verwandeln Sie komplexe Protokollaktualisierungen, kryptographische Primitive und technische Dokumentation in hochgradig visuelle, verdauliche Entwicklerinhalte (wie Code-Along-Videos, Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen und interaktive Repositorien).

• Zusammenarbeit mit Core Devs: Arbeiten Sie eng mit unseren P2P-Protokoll- und Produktentwicklungsteams zusammen, um den kommenden Pear and Bare-Funktionen einen Schritt voraus zu sein.

• Prototypen: Schnelle Prototypen von Anwendungskonzepten – wie z. B. die Erstellung einer Peer-to-Peer-Chat-, File-Sync- oder Data-Replication-Demo –, um zu zeigen, wie schnell Entwickler robuste, serverlose Produkte mit unserem Ökosystem starten können.

• Influencer-geführte Entwicklerakzeptanz: Arbeiten Sie mit technischen Influencern, Entwicklervertretern und Content-Erstellern zusammen, um unser Ökosystem zu erweitern. Sie werden ihnen schlüsselfertige technische Assets zur Verfügung stellen, gemeinsam Code-Along-Herausforderungen erstellen und sie mit den hochwertigen Demos und Prototypen ausstatten, die benötigt werden, um neue Entwickler für Pear and Bare zu inspirieren und an Bord zu bringen.

• 3 bis 6+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer technischen Rolle wie Technical Content Creation, Solutions Engineering oder Backend/Systems Development.

• Starke Programmierkenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Sprachen, die in unserem Ökosystem verwendet werden (wie NodeJS, C / C ++), um mit Peer-to-Peer-Netzwerken und Runtime-Interna sicher zu interagieren.

• Domain Expertise: Solides Verständnis von Peer-to-Peer (P2P)-Netzwerken, verteilten Systemen, Datenstrukturen im Hypercore/Append-only-Log-Stil und dezentraler Anwendungsarchitektur.

• Demo-/Video-Produktionsfähigkeiten: Erleben Sie die Aufnahme und Bearbeitung polierter technischer Bildschirmfreigaben, Terminalaufnahmen oder Video-Tutorials (mit Tools wie Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow usw.).

• Empathie für Entwickler: Die Fähigkeit, ein komplexes P2P-Protokoll oder eine Laufzeit zu betrachten und genau zu verstehen, welche Art von Demo- oder Beispielprojekt Entwickler und Infrastrukturbetreiber dazu bringt, mit dem Bau zu beginnen.

• Self-Starter Mindset: Komfortables autonomes Arbeiten in einer abgelegenen, verteilten Umgebung in globalen Zeitzonen.

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben LinkedIn-Profile verifiziert. Wenn sie unsicher sind, können sie ihre identität bestätigen, indem sie ihr profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere website kontaktieren.

• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.

• Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden.

• Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details verlangen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, ist dies ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort.

Fühlen Sie sich im Zweifelsfall frei, über unsere offizielle Website zu erreichen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Joindre Tether et façonner l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises – des échanges et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets – d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques pionniers.
Mais c'est juste le début :
Tether Power: moteur de la croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisation de l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Nous recherchons un Créateur de Contenu Technique pour mettre en valeur le pouvoir pratique de la pile pair à pair de Tether. Il s'agit d'un rôle axé sur le constructeur conçu pour un ingénieur ou un créateur hautement technique qui comble l'écart entre l'infrastructure de bas niveau, la cryptographie et l'application fonctionnelle.

Nous ne sommes pas à la recherche d'un marchand de médias sociaux ou d'un influenceur sur caméra. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un conteur technique qui peut écrire du code, spin up peer-to-peer nœuds, construire des applications Bare fonctionnelles, et enregistrer des démos polies, claires, partage d'écran. Vous transformerez notre pile de base (Pear et Bare) en une série continue de prototypes visuels et pratiques "build-in-public" qui prouvent au monde à quoi ressemble une véritable infrastructure décentralisée, pair à pair.

Responsabilités

• Construisez des démonstrations pratiques : Construisez indépendamment des applications et des configurations d'infrastructure de pair à pair en utilisant la plate-forme Pear et le runtime Bare avec un minimum d'ingénierie main.

• Démos techniques d'enregistrement : enregistrez clairement, engageant, et de haute qualité de partage d'écran et de démonstrations vidéo de vos constructions, en soulignant comment le code fonctionne, comment les pairs se découvrent et se synchronisent, et la valeur que les systèmes fournissent.

• Translate Code to Content: Transformez les mises à jour complexes du protocole, les primitives cryptographiques et la documentation technique en contenu de développeur hautement visuel et digestible (comme les vidéos longues de code, les guides étape par étape et les dépôts interactifs).

• Collaborez avec Core Devs: Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de protocole et d'ingénierie de produits P2P pour rester en avance sur les prochaines fonctionnalités de Pear et Bare.

• Prototypes : Des concepts d'applications prototypes rapides – comme la création d'un chat pair-à-pair, d'un fichier-sync ou d'une démo de récupération de données – pour montrer à quel point les développeurs peuvent lancer rapidement des produits résilients et sans serveur en utilisant notre écosystème.

• Influenceur de carburant-Led Developer Adoption: Collaborer avec les influenceurs techniques, les défenseurs des développeurs et les créateurs de contenu pour amplifier notre écosystème. Vous leur fournirez des atouts techniques clés en main, co-créerez des défis de code-long, et les armerez avec les démos et prototypes de haute qualité nécessaires pour inspirer et à bord de nouveaux développeurs à Pear et Bare.

• 3 à 6 ans d'expérience dans un rôle technique comme la création de contenu technique, l'ingénierie de solutions ou le développement de backend/systems.

• Compétences de programmation fortes : Compétence dans les langues utilisées dans notre écosystème (comme NodeJS, C/C++) pour interagir avec confiance avec les réseaux de pairs et les internes d'exécution.

• Expertise du domaine: Compréhension solide des réseaux de pairs (P2P), des systèmes distribués, des structures de données de style hypercore/append only-log et de l'architecture d'application décentralisée.

• Compétences de production de démonstration/vidéo : Expérience d'enregistrement et d'édition de partages d'écrans techniques polis, d'enregistrements terminaux ou de tutoriels vidéo (en utilisant des outils comme Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow, etc.).

• Empathy du développeur : La capacité de regarder un protocole complexe P2P ou l'exécution et de comprendre exactement quel type de projet de démonstration ou d'échantillon va inciter les développeurs et les opérateurs d'infrastructure à commencer à construire.

• Self-Starter Mindset: Confortable travaillant de manière autonome dans un environnement éloigné et distribué dans les fuseaux horaires mondiaux.

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par l'intermédiaire de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are seeking a highly driven, organized, and entrepreneurial USAT Institutional Associate to accelerate market adoption, operational connectivity, and execution across core global corridors. As capacity expands across our pipeline, this role will serve as the execution engine for regional expansion initiatives, cross border pilots, and institutional onboarding.
 Reporting directly to the Head of USAT Institutional, you will take hands on ownership of high priority operational workflows, bridge regional expansion teams, and project manage strategic corridor partnerships from inception to production. The ideal candidate thrives in fast paced environments, possesses a strong baseline in fintech and digital asset execution, and is eager to be directly mentored while driving high impact output.

Responsibilities

• Ramp Connectivity & Corridor Optimization

• Partner closely with regional expansion leadership to identify, establish, and optimize on/off-ramp infrastructures across high value corridors to drive seamless global connectivity.

• Analyze fiat and stablecoin liquidity flows to inform data driven operational decisions and eliminate friction in payment ecosystems.

• Local FX Pilots & Production Execution

• Lead and execute local stablecoin FX pilots.

• Establish clear milestone roadmaps to transition successful pilots into active production environments.

• Geographic Project Management & Sourcing

• Serve as primary project manager for active geographic expansion initiatives

• Conduct market research and track regulatory shifts to source, evaluate, and prioritize new corridor expansion opportunities.

• Institutional Onboarding & Operational Execution

• Manage day-to-day operational execution and compliance requirements as tier-1 US institutions adopt USAT.

• Maintain structured KPI tracking, status reporting, and internal alignment to guarantee execution velocity across active institutional workflows.

• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. 3–6 years of experience in project management, business development, or operational execution within fintech, cross-border payments, banking, or digital assets.

• Execution & Project Management: Proven track record of managing complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating technical/regulatory workstreams, and driving projects from concept to close.

• Domain Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of cross-border settlements, payment rails, stablecoin mechanics, and regional fintech ecosystems.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to interface seamlessly with internal partners, regional leads, and institutional external clients.

• Mindset: Proactive, organized, and comfortable navigating ambiguity independently in a high-velocity ecosystem.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Stiamo cercando un altamente guidato, organizzato e imprenditoriale USAT Istituzionale Associate per accelerare l'adozione del mercato, la connettività operativa e l'esecuzione attraverso corridoi globali di base. Poiché la capacità si espande attraverso la nostra pipeline, questo ruolo servirà come motore di esecuzione per iniziative di espansione regionale, piloti transfrontalieri e onboarding istituzionale.
Segnalandosi direttamente al Capo di Stati UnitiT Istituzionale, si prenderanno le mani sulla proprietà dei flussi di lavoro operativi ad alta priorità, ponte team di espansione regionale, e il progetto gestire partnership corridoi strategici dall'inizio alla produzione. Il candidato ideale prospera in ambienti veloci, possiede una forte linea di base nell'esecuzione di asset fintech e digitale, ed è impaziente di essere direttamente mentorizzato durante la guida di un'alta potenza di impatto.

responsabilità

• Connettività & Ottimizzazione del Corridoio

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con la leadership di espansione regionale per identificare, stabilire e ottimizzare le infrastrutture on/off-ramp in corridoi ad alto valore per guidare la connettività globale senza soluzione di continuità.

• Analizzare i flussi di liquiditÃ fiat e stablecoin per informare le decisioni operative e eliminare l'attrito negli ecosistemi di pagamento.

• Piloti locali e esecuzione di produzione

• Guidare ed eseguire i piloti locali stablecoin FX.

• Stabilire chiare roadmap di pietra miliare per i piloti di transizione di successo in ambienti di produzione attivi.

• Gestione e Sourcing del progetto geografico

• Serve come responsabile del progetto primario per iniziative di espansione geografica attiva

• Condurre la ricerca di mercato e monitorare i cambiamenti normativi alla fonte, valutare e priorità nuove opportunità di espansione corridoio.

• Istituzionali onboard & Esecuzione operativa

• Gestire l'esecuzione operativa quotidiana e i requisiti di conformità come tier-1 istituzioni statunitensi adottano USAT.

• Mantenere tracciamento KPI strutturato, report di stato e allineamento interno per garantire velocità di esecuzione attraverso flussi di lavoro istituzionali attivi.

• Istruzione e esperienza: laurea in Business, Finanza, Economia o un campo relativo. 3–6 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti, nello sviluppo aziendale o nell'esecuzione operativa all'interno di attività finanziarie, transfrontaliere, bancarie o digitali.

• Execution & Project Management: Proven track record di gestione di complesse iniziative interfunzionali, coordinando i flussi di lavoro tecnici/regolatori e guidando progetti da concept a close.

• Conoscenza del dominio: Solida comprensione fondativa degli insediamenti transfrontalieri, delle guide di pagamento, della meccanica stabile del carbone e degli ecosistemi fintech regionali.

• Comunicazione & Stakeholder Management: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali. Capacità di interfacciarsi senza soluzione di continuità con i partner interni, i lead regionali e i clienti esterni istituzionali.

• Mindset: Proattivo, organizzato e confortevole ambiguità di navigazione indipendentemente in un ecosistema ad alta velocità.

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.

• Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

We are seeking a highly driven, organized, and entrepreneurial USAT Institutional Associate to accelerate market adoption, operational connectivity, and execution across core global corridors. Reporting directly to the Head of USAT Institutional, you will take hands on ownership of high priority operational workflows, bridge regional expansion teams, and project manage strategic corridor partnerships from inception to production. The ideal candidate thrives in fast paced environments, possesses a strong baseline in fintech and digital asset execution, and is eager to be directly mentored while driving high impact output.

• Ramp Connectivity & Corridor Optimization

• Partner closely with regional expansion leadership to identify, establish, and optimize on/off-ramp infrastructures across high value corridors to drive seamless global connectivity.

• Local FX Pilots & Production Execution

• Lead and execute local stablecoin FX pilots.

• Establish clear milestone roadmaps to transition successful pilots into active production environments.

• Geographic Project Management & Sourcing

• Serve as primary project manager for active geographic expansion initiatives

• Conduct market research and track regulatory shifts to source, evaluate, and prioritize new corridor expansion opportunities.

• Institutional Onboarding & Operational Execution

• Manage day-to-day operational execution and compliance requirements as tier-1 US institutions adopt USAT.

• Maintain structured KPI tracking, status reporting, and internal alignment to guarantee execution velocity across active institutional workflows.

• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. 3–6 years of experience in project management, business development, or operational execution within fintech, cross-border payments, banking, or digital assets.

• Execution & Project Management: Proven track record of managing complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating technical/regulatory workstreams, and driving projects from concept to close.

• Domain Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of cross-border settlements, payment rails, stablecoin mechanics, and regional fintech ecosystems.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to interface seamlessly with internal partners, regional leads, and institutional external clients.

• Mindset: Proactive, organized, and comfortable navigating ambiguity independently in a high-velocity ecosystem.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début:
Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un USAT Institutional Associate hautement motivé, organisé et entrepreneurial pour accélérer l'adoption du marché, la connectivité opérationnelle et l'exécution dans les corridors mondiaux de base. Au fur et à mesure que la capacité s'étendra dans l'ensemble de notre pipeline, ce rôle servira de moteur d'exécution pour les initiatives d'expansion régionale, les projets pilotes transfrontaliers et l'embarquement institutionnel.
Relevant directement du responsable de l'USAT Institutional, vous prendrez la main sur l'appropriation des flux de travail opérationnels hautement prioritaires, établirez un pont entre les équipes d'expansion régionale et gérerez les partenariats stratégiques entre corridors de départ et production. Le candidat idéal prospère dans des environnements à rythme rapide, possède une base solide en fintech et l'exécution d'actifs numériques, et est impatient d'être directement encadré tout en conduisant une production à impact élevé.

Responsabilités

• Connectivité Ramp & Optimisation du Corridor

• Collaborer étroitement avec le leadership en matière d'expansion régionale pour identifier, établir et optimiser les infrastructures sur et hors rampe dans les corridors à haute valeur ajoutée afin de favoriser une connectivité mondiale sans faille.

• Analyser les flux de liquidités fiduciaires et stables pour éclairer les décisions opérationnelles fondées sur les données et éliminer les frictions dans les écosystèmes de paiement.

• Pilotes FX locaux et exécution de production

• Dirigez et exécutez des pilotes locaux de écurie FX.

• Établir des feuilles de route claires pour la transition des projets pilotes réussis vers des environnements de production actifs.

• Gestion et approvisionnement de projets géographiques

• À titre de gestionnaire principal de projet pour les initiatives actives d'expansion géographique

• Effectuer des études de marché et suivre les changements réglementaires vers la source, évaluer et prioriser les nouvelles possibilités d'expansion des corridors.

• Installation et exécution opérationnelle

• Gérer l'exécution opérationnelle quotidienne et les exigences de conformité lorsque les institutions américaines de niveau 1 adoptent USAT.

• Maintenir un suivi structuré de l'ICP, un rapport d'état et un alignement interne pour garantir la vitesse d'exécution des flux de travail institutionnels actifs.

• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat en affaires, finance, économie ou un domaine connexe. 3 à 6 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de projets, le développement d'entreprises ou l'exécution opérationnelle au sein d'actifs financiers, de paiements transfrontaliers, bancaires ou numériques.

• Exécution et gestion de projet : Expérience éprouvée de la gestion d'initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes, de la coordination des volets techniques et réglementaires et de la conduite des projets d'un concept à l'autre.

• Connaissance du domaine: Compréhension fondamentale solide des règlements transfrontaliers, des rails de paiement, de la mécanique des monnaies stables et des écosystèmes fintech régionaux.

• Communication et gestion des intervenants : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale. Capacité d'interagir de façon transparente avec les partenaires internes, les dirigeants régionaux et les clients externes institutionnels.

• Mindset: Ambiguité de navigation proactive, organisée et confortable indépendamment dans un écosystème à haute vitesse.

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lors de la demande de rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Faites attention aux méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par le biais de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

Responsibilities

Architecture . Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

Team leadership. Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer . Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement. Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

Managed inference at scale. Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

Observability and operations. Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

Partners and vendors. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

Internal consumers. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

Hiring . Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

Must have

• Experience. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Slurm at scale, hands on. Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.

• GPU fleet operation on bare metal. NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn-in and acceptance.

• High-performance interconnects. InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR-IOV, and diagnosing multi-node NCCL performance problems.

• Linux systems depth . Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute-heavy workloads.

• Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment: control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi-tenancy design.

• HPC storage and data movement. Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.

• Observability and operations. Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post-incident review.

• Working fluency in JavaScript and Node.js sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature-development requirement.

• A shipped platform with real users. A multi-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user-facing API and CLI surfaces.

• Leadership that stays in the code. People management across time zones, cross-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.

• Location . Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

Desirable

• Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

• Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade-offs, GPU memory planning.

• VM and container isolation for multi-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA confidential-compute mode).

• Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.

• Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.

• Peer-to-peer or distributed-systems background.

• Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

Responsibilities

Architecture . Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

Team leadership. Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer . Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement. Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

Managed inference at scale. Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

Observability and operations. Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

Partners and vendors. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

Internal consumers. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

Hiring . Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

Must have

• Experience. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Slurm at scale, hands on. Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.

• GPU fleet operation on bare metal. NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn-in and acceptance.

• High-performance interconnects. InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR-IOV, and diagnosing multi-node NCCL performance problems.

• Linux systems depth . Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute-heavy workloads.

• Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment: control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi-tenancy design.

• HPC storage and data movement. Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.

• Observability and operations. Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post-incident review.

• Working fluency in JavaScript and Node.js sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature-development requirement.

• A shipped platform with real users. A multi-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user-facing API and CLI surfaces.

• Leadership that stays in the code. People management across time zones, cross-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.

• Location . Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

Desirable

• Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

• Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade-offs, GPU memory planning.

• VM and container isolation for multi-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA confidential-compute mode).

• Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.

• Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.

• Peer-to-peer or distributed-systems background.

• Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
